meaning: to visit relatives (esp. a married daughter returning to her natal home, or general visiting/socializing among kin)

example.hakka: 禮拜六𠊎愛去阿婆該行嫁。
example.romanization: Lî-pai-liuk ngài oi hi â-phò kâi hàng-ka.
example.english: On Saturday I'm going to visit relatives at Grandma's place.

note: Traditionally this referred specifically to a married-out daughter visiting her birth family, a valued social custom in Hakka villages; today it's used more loosely for visiting relatives or friends in general.
